description:
One raw event plus ingest metadata.

Stored in stream `events` as a single field `envelope` holding this model as JSON (orjson).
`payload` is the raw event exactly as received (a parsed log line for `log_tail`).

event_id.description: ULID assigned by ingest; sortable by time.
event_id.title: Event Id

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key header, else sha256 of source_id + canonical payload JSON.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

sent_at.description: Producer send time (X-Sent-At header); used for alert_e2e_latency_seconds.
sent_at.title: Sent At

title: EventEnvelope
